scope: Every version 1 configuration, Markdown, artifact, adapter, diagnostic, fingerprint, and gate contract required before runtime implementation.

mapping_semantics.contracts.requirements: Target Requirements that normatively constrain the contract.
mapping_semantics.contracts.fixture_families: Fixture families that exercise the contract directly or as a composed dependency.
mapping_semantics.fixture_families.contracts: Primary wire contracts instantiated or emitted by that fixture family.
mapping_semantics.directionality: The two fixture mappings are intentionally directional and are not required to be symmetric.

metadata.source_of_truth: Inventory of planned contracts; product Requirements remain authoritative for behavior.
known_staleness_risks: A target Requirement or architecture contract changes without updating this inventory.
Stage 0.2 materializes a schema with a different wire name or major version.
A new gate or adapter record is added only to prose.

consistency_assertions.rule: No two contracts in the same category and major version use the same wire_name unless they are different JSONL record types.
Every compatibility, ordering, limit, and provenance profile reference resolves.
Every fixture contract and gate output reference resolves to contracts[].contract_id.
Every contracts[].fixture_families entry resolves to fixture_families[].fixture_family_id.
Every REQ identifier exists in proposal/spec.
Every contract version matches the shape required by its compatibility profile.
Every decision-bearing artifact uses json-v1-strict or gate-v1 compatibility.
Every fixture family has at least one contract, Requirement, and required case.

stage_0_2_detail_queue.reason: The command protocol names the selection file but does not yet publish its complete schema.
